    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "budget = df[\"Budget\"].sum()\n",
        "actual = df[\"Actual_Cost\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "bars = plt.bar(\n",
        "    [\"Budget\", \"Actual Cost\"],\n",
        "        [budget, actual],\n",
        "            color=[\"royalblue\", \"tomato\"],\n",
        "                edgecolor=\"black\",\n",
        "                    linewidth=2\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Budget vs Actual Cost\", fontsize=18, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Amount (₹)\", fontsize=12)\n",
        "\n",
        "for bar in bars:\n",
        "                        y = bar.get_height()\n",
        "plt.text(\n",
        "                                    bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2,\n",
        "                                            y,\n",
        "                                                    f\"₹{y/100000:.1f}L\",\n",
        "                                                            ha=\"center\",\n",
        "                                                                    va=\"bottom\",\n",
        "                                                                            fontsize=11,\n",
        "                                                                                    fontweight=\"bold\"\n",
        "                                                                                        )\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.grid(axis=\"y\", linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
